description: Reference verdicts for experimental hold_policy (docs/media-buy/task-reference/refine_proposals.mdx#hold-policy-experimental). Each finalize vector is a refine_proposals finalize request, the seller's records of the source drafts, the request and response times a grader observed, and the seller response or task-level error; each draft vector is a draft with its allocated products; each replay vector is an exact retry graded against the original response. expected.violations lists every rule the input breaks, using the codes in violation_codes; an empty list means conformant. The shape is experimental and may change with the feature.

conventions.duration: Durations are ISO 8601 day, hour, minute, and second parts only. A day is exactly 86400 seconds added to the UTC instant: no calendar, time-zone, or daylight-saving arithmetic. Durations are compared after normalizing to elapsed time, so P1D equals PT24H.
conventions.hold_placement: The hold is placed when the seller creates the committed proposal, and a committed proposal whose hold_policy.available is true records that instant in hold_placed_at. observation.request_received_at is when the seller received the finalize request and observation.response_at is when it responded or, for a submitted finalize, when the task completed; hold_placed_at must lie in that window. Callers below 3.3 receive no hold_placed_at. For them placement lies somewhere in the window, and a bound is a violation only when it fails for every placement in it; a bound that passes for some placements and fails for others is reported in expected.indeterminate and is not a violation.
conventions.bounds: For a holdable draft (effective available true) that declares them: expires_at >= placement + min_duration and expires_at <= placement + max_duration. A no-hold committed proposal has an acceptance window, not a hold, so neither bound applies.
conventions.effective_policy: A draft or product without hold_policy takes the seller hold_semantics: terms_only means { available: false }, and inventory_hold or absent means { available: true } with no durations and extendable false.
conventions.source_drafts: source_drafts are the seller's records of the drafts as it serves them at 3.3. Serving a caller below 3.3, the seller omits hold_policy on the wire, but the grader still resolves the effective policy from these records.
conventions.presence: A seller that lists media_buy.hold_policy includes hold_policy on every draft and committed proposal for callers at 3.3 or later. For callers below 3.3 it omits hold_policy and hold_placed_at from every product and proposal in the response.
conventions.draft_derivation: A holdable draft derives from its allocated products' effective policies: its min_duration and max_duration do not exceed the max_duration of any allocated product that declares one, its max_total_duration does not exceed that of any allocated product that declares one, and it is extendable only if every allocated product is extendable. Product policies are otherwise planning hints.
conventions.duration_order: Within one hold_policy, min_duration <= max_duration <= max_total_duration after normalizing. The schema cannot compare durations, so the grader checks this.
conventions.adcp_version: The caller version is request.adcp_version, compared by major and minor.
conventions.extension: An extend_hold vector grades one refine_proposals extend_hold request against source_proposals, the seller records of the committed sources. A successful extension returns a committed successor with the source commercial_terms, terms_digest, hold_policy, and hold_placed_at unchanged and a later expires_at no later than hold_placed_at + max_total_duration. Because hold_placed_at is carried forward, the ceiling is measured from the root finalize placement across the whole chain. extendable defaults to false. A source that holds no inventory fails the request at task level with INVALID_STATE, never hold_unavailable.
conventions.ranking: rankable (experimental, media_buy.hold_ranking) is part of hold_policy, forbidden when available is false, and defaults to false. A committed proposal whose policy has available and rankable true carries hold_rank (1 = first position; the worst position when the hold covers inventory at several). hold_rank is forbidden otherwise and on drafts. A draft is rankable if any allocated product effective policy is rankable, so a draft without rankable true beside a rankable product promises more than the product. An extend_hold successor reports hold_rank as of the extension and never a worse position than its source. A seller emitting rankable or hold_rank lists media_buy.hold_ranking.
conventions.installment_holds: holds (experimental, media_buy.installment_holds) is readback of the installments one committed hold covers, not separate holds. It appears only on a committed proposal whose hold_policy has available true, lists each (product_id, installment_ref) once, and names only products in commercial_terms.purchases. Entries share the proposal hold_placed_at and expires_at and carry no expires_at of their own. Under a rankable policy every entry carries hold_rank and the proposal hold_rank is the worst entry position. An extend_hold successor lists the same entries, each at a position no worse than in its source. A seller emitting holds lists media_buy.installment_holds.
conventions.installment_deadlines: A finalize vector may carry installments, the seller records (after any computation from deadline_policy) of the booking_deadline and change_cutoff (core/installment-deadlines.json) for the installments of each product the drafts allocate. The earliest of them across the draft allocated products is the latest instant a hold may run to: expires_at must not be later (equal is allowed). If placement + min_duration would fall after it, the seller cannot honor the minimum and returns hold_unavailable, with batch_aborted siblings (the grader does not judge whether a hold_unavailable was warranted, since a seller may fail a finalize for its own reasons); committing anyway breaks min_duration (expires_at at the deadline) or the deadline cap (expires_at at placement + min_duration), so no committed result is conformant. Deadlines of products the draft does not allocate are ignored.
conventions.replay: A replay vector grades an exact retry of a finalize that returned a response (not a task error) (same idempotency_key and request) against the original response. original.observation and original.response are graded as a finalize vector. replay.response is flagged replayed: true and must return the same results, in the same order (results and products are compared): each finalized entry carries the original committed proposal with its original hold_placed_at and expires_at (a retry never restarts the clock; a completed result is replayed as cached, per the idempotency rules in docs/building/by-layer/L1/security.mdx, including an all-unable result), and each unable entry repeats its original reason_code. The retry is not checked against a new observation window, so a replayed hold_placed_at earlier than the retry is expected.

violation_codes.schema_invalid: A request, draft, product, response, or task error fails its JSON Schema. A grader reports only this code for the vector.
violation_codes.min_duration_not_honored: expires_at is earlier than placement + min_duration (for every possible placement when hold_placed_at is not on the wire).
violation_codes.max_duration_exceeded: expires_at is later than placement + max_duration (for every possible placement when hold_placed_at is not on the wire).
violation_codes.hold_placed_at_outside_window: A committed hold_placed_at is earlier than request_received_at or later than response_at.
violation_codes.hold_policy_not_carried_forward: A committed proposal hold_policy differs from its source draft hold_policy, including being added or dropped.
violation_codes.terms_digest_mismatch: A committed terms_digest is not the sha256 base64url digest of the RFC 8785 serialization of its commercial_terms.
violation_codes.commercial_terms_changed: A committed proposal commercial_terms differ from its source draft; finalize changes no terms.
violation_codes.experimental_feature_undeclared: A draft, committed proposal, or product carries hold_policy but the seller experimental_features omits media_buy.hold_policy. For hold_policy.rankable or hold_rank, the feature is media_buy.hold_ranking. For holds, the feature is media_buy.installment_holds.
violation_codes.hold_unavailable_without_hold: An entry whose effective policy has available false returns hold_unavailable.
violation_codes.batch_aborted_without_cause: An entry returns batch_aborted but no sibling entry failed for its own reason.
violation_codes.terms_only_committed_below_3_3: A committed proposal whose effective policy has available false is returned to a caller below AdCP 3.3.
violation_codes.hold_policy_sent_below_3_3: A product or proposal returned to a caller below AdCP 3.3 carries hold_policy, hold_placed_at, hold_rank, or holds.
violation_codes.unsupported_feature_without_cause: A finalize batch fails with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE although the caller is at AdCP 3.3 or later or every draft is holdable, so the version gate does not apply.
violation_codes.hold_policy_missing: The seller lists media_buy.hold_policy and the caller is at AdCP 3.3 or later, but a draft or committed proposal omits hold_policy.
violation_codes.draft_exceeds_product_policy: A holdable draft promises more than an allocated product's effective policy: a min_duration or max_duration above a product max_duration, a max_total_duration above a product max_total_duration, or extendable true when a product is not extendable.
violation_codes.hold_policy_durations_unordered: A hold_policy has min_duration > max_duration or max_duration > max_total_duration after normalizing.
violation_codes.draft_available_inconsistent: A draft declares available true although an allocated product effective policy has available false.
violation_codes.max_total_duration_exceeded: An extend_hold successor expires_at is later than the original hold_placed_at + max_total_duration.
violation_codes.hold_placed_at_not_carried_forward: An extend_hold successor hold_placed_at differs from its source; the root finalize placement is carried forward unchanged.
violation_codes.extension_not_later: An extend_hold successor expires_at is not later than its source expires_at.
violation_codes.extended_while_not_extendable: An extend_hold succeeds against a source whose hold_policy.extendable is false or absent (it defaults to false).
violation_codes.no_hold_wrong_task_error: An extend_hold request against a committed proposal that holds no inventory fails at task level with a code other than INVALID_STATE.
violation_codes.hold_rank_worsened: An extend_hold successor reports a worse (larger) hold_rank than its source. A seller never moves a live hold to a worse position. The same applies to each holds entry.
violation_codes.holds_duplicate_entry: holds lists the same product_id and installment_ref more than once.
violation_codes.holds_product_not_allocated: A holds entry names a product_id that is not in the committed proposal commercial_terms.purchases.
violation_codes.hold_rank_better_than_entry: The proposal hold_rank is a better (smaller) position than some holds entry hold_rank; it must be the worst position.
violation_codes.holds_changed_on_extension: An extend_hold successor lists a different set of holds entries than its source. Extension transfers the same hold.
violation_codes.hold_past_installment_deadline: A committed hold expires_at is later than the earliest booking_deadline or change_cutoff of the allocated products installments.
violation_codes.replay_hold_restarted: An exact retry under the same idempotency key returns a committed proposal whose hold_placed_at or expires_at differs from the original response.
violation_codes.replay_response_changed: An exact retry under the same idempotency key returns results that differ from the original response in any way other than the changed hold times, such as another outcome, reason_code, or committed proposal_id.
